title: Chapter 209 Immortal King Savior
content:
Chapter 209 Immortal King Savior

Suddenly, Duan Hen was stunned.

At this time, Wan Feng looked at Duan Hen and continued, "What's the purpose of coming to my wasteland city?"

Hearing this, Duan Hen said, "I am here to find a powerful sword cultivator."

"but,,"

After a pause, Duan Hen's face suddenly became a little sighed.

"It's disappointing, very disappointing."

"No one in the whole city can fight."

At this time, Wan Feng's fists were slowly clenched.

Even Huang Shou's face was a little ugly.

Seeing this, Duan Hen smiled and said, "You'd better forget it. If it were at your peak, I might have looked at you more. Unfortunately, now,

Duan Hen shook his head.

I have to say that Duan Hen is very arrogant.

But he has this arrogant capital.

Not to mention the Wood Immortal Realm, even if you look at the entire Immortal Realm, there are very few who can stabilize Duan Hen.

It’s a pity that the Wood Fairy Realm is no longer the Wood Fairy Realm that was back then.

"Are you awesome?"

At this moment, a cold voice suddenly sounded from the field.

Suddenly, Duan Hen's face changed.

laugh!

The space cracked, and a beautiful woman slowly walked out of the crack in the space.

"Master!"

"I've met Mrs.

When they saw the woman, Wan Feng and the others looked excited.

"Who are you?"

Seeing Yan Lingyun, the smile on Duan Hen's face disappeared instantly, and a solemn expression replaced it.

This person is not simple, this is how he feels at this moment.

"I'm asking you, are you strong?"

Yan Lingyun did not answer Duan Hen’s question, but asked again.

Seeing this, Duan Hen nodded, "I take back what I said before, there are indeed strong people in your Huangcheng."

"I just don't know how strong it is."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun sneered.

"Try it?"

......

Above the deserted city, there is a void.

Two figures were facing each other from afar. One was wearing a long robe and holding a long sword. His aura was revealed. His whole body stood proudly like a peerless magic sword, as if a terrifying sword energy would burst out in the next moment.

Another one, with a superb charm, a domineering aura and a cold expression, was definitely an iceberg beauty with her hands behind her, as if she had already been invincible in the world.

"Let me take action, let me see if the Wood Fairy Realm has made progress over the years."

At this time, Duan Hen spoke first.

In the distance, Yan Lingyun said coldly: "Remember, this sentence will be the last thing you regret in the Wood Fairy Realm."

boom!

Yan Lingyun took a step forward and then punched her hard.

Suddenly, billions of fist lights intertwined, mixed with a destructive aura rushed towards Duan Heng in the distance, and all the space was broken wherever he passed.

Seeing this terrifying punch towards him, Duan Hen's heart had already been filled with storms.

He knew that the woman in front of him would be very strong, but he didn't expect that she would be so strong.

"cut!"

laugh!

Facing this punch, Duan Hen did not dare to have any reservations at all, and the first sword used his full strength.

Rumble!

The fist light collided with the sword light, and countless terrifying mushroom clouds rose from the void, looking like several spectacular.

However, before the fluctuation ended, a figure suddenly rushed forward.

Duan Hen's pupils shrank sharply, and he quickly slashed forward with his sword.

However, it was too late, and there was no choice but to hold the sword in front of him.

boom!

Yan Lingyun directly punched Duan Hen's sword body with one punch.

Just heard a loud noise, Duan Hen retreated hundreds of thousands of feet from the void. The powerful rear force made the void crack continuously. Until the end, Duan Hen suddenly kicked the void and then was so stubborn that it was so suffocated. Stopped.

Puff ~

A mouthful of blood spurted out of his mouth.

Duan Hen's face turned pale in an instant.

"Do you still need to continue?"

In the distant void, Yan Lingyun said in a faint voice.

Hearing this, Duan Hen's face looked a little ugly, but he was very convinced.

I have no choice but to say that my skills are not as good as others.

"I lost."

Duan Hen took his long sword and bowed to Yan Lingyun.

Seeing Duan Hen admit defeat, Yan Lingyun turned around and was about to leave.

And at this moment, Duan Hen suddenly said, "Girl, I have a question."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun looked at Duan Hen.

Duan Hen said, "Girl, not long ago, a strong sword cultivator swung a sword towards the fairy realm and directly shattered the barrier of the fairy realm. I wonder if the girl knows this."

A powerful sword cultivator.

In the distance, Wan Feng and the others looked at each other with a little confused expression.

A powerful sword cultivator? Crush the barrier of the Immortal Realm?

Could it be that there are strong people in the Wood Immortal Realm who don’t even know about it?

However, Yan Lingyun in the void guessed the identity of the powerful sword cultivator Duan Hen mentioned.

There is no strong sword cultivator, he is just a child.

That's right, in Yan Lingyun's eyes, Lu Xue is as simple as a child.

The most important thing is that Lu Xue is her child.

"Is this why you came to the Wood Fairy World?"

Yan Lingyun asked.

Upon hearing this, Duan Hen nodded, "Do you know?"

Yan Lingyun said in a faint voice: "That has nothing to do with you. It's time for you to leave the Wood Fairy Realm."

Hearing this, Duan Hen frowned slightly.

At this time, Yan Lingyun had already turned around and left.

Just when Duan Hen wanted to speak again, Yan Lingyun suddenly said, "I am not discussing with you after leaving the Wood Fairy Realm."

Suddenly, Duan Hen was stunned.

Looking at Yan Lingyun's departure back, Duan Hen was silent for a long time, but finally chose to leave.

"Go away."

"Go away."

Wan Feng and the others watched Duan Hen leave, with expressionless faces on their faces.

I can't pretend well, so I have to come to their wasteland city to wear it.

Being beaten up.

"It seems that the city lord is really in seclusion."

At this time, Huang Shoudao.

Such an arrogant person came, but the city lord didn't come out.

On the side, Wan Feng smiled and said nothing.

In the entire wasteland city, the only one who knew about Lu Daosheng's affairs was left besides Yan Lingyun and Lu Xue.

Of course, she wouldn't say anything about this.

After a few simple greetings, Wan Feng returned to the city lord's mansion.

At the same time, the fairyland began to become lively.

Xiao Clan of the Immortal Realm.

"Second Elder, Third Elder, you are back!"

Dozens of figures rushed towards Xiao Chen and Xiao Xuanmu, with joyful smiles on their faces.

"Everyone, nothing major happened in the clan recently, right?"

Xiao Chen nodded and asked immediately.

Hearing this, everyone shook their heads, but the smiles on their faces became restrained.

"Second Elder, we listened to you and just stayed outside the ancestral mountain, so nothing happened."

"However, those people from those forces are already eyeing our tribe."

The person in charge spoke.

As soon as these words were spoken, a touch of solemnity appeared on Xiao Chen's face.

And just then, a man suddenly said, "Two elders, have you come back to find a solution?"

Suddenly, everyone looked at Xiao Chen and Xiao Xuanmu with hope.

Xiao Chen coughed lightly and pointed sideways at Lu Xue behind the two of them.

Because he was afraid of being targeted, Lu Xue had already put Ao Qing away.

"This is the savior I and the two of us have come to solve the crisis in our clan."

Everyone looked at Lu Xue together, and the scene suddenly became silent.

Immortal King. . .
